text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
On the "Indispensable to Races! Top 
Supporting Player Umamusume Rankings"...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~ Hearing you call it "indispensable" 
makes me so happy for your patronage!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can really feel their support down 
to my bones, sir... But that's exactly 
why...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, we can't be negative...! Take it in 
stride, and next time for sure—!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Shion-san's face just now, I 
think I kind of get it... The reason why 
everyone wants to cheer for her.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are you saying...! If you're 
bringing that up, Nature-san, look at your 
fan comments!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Every 'next time for sure' gets my blood 
pumping!" "We love seeing Nature try her 
hardest!"—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa...! Please don't read it 
out loud here...!
